objective: Reduce checkout page load time by 30% on mobile devices.
context: Mobile traffic spike during flash sales. Current LCP is 4.2s, target < 2.5s. Constraints: budget limited to frontend changes only (no CDN upgrade).

expected_flow.action: Identify render-blocking resources, identify lazy-load candidates
Select top 2 critical images to inline + implement image-optimized fallback

expected_flow.result: LCP drops to 1.8s, CLS stable at 0.04

context: Current conversion: 2.1%. Audience: existing app users who didn't subscribe in last 3 months. Constraints: single change per iteration, max 2 variants, run for 7 days min.

expected_flow.action: Hypothesize: CTA placement or copy clarity is bottleneck
Test A: sticky bottom CTA. Test B: inline contextual prompt

expected_flow.result: A improves to 2.8%, B to 2.3%. Winner: A

objective: Validate whether expanding into EU market is viable within Q4.
context: Current revenue from APAC: $1.2M. EU market size: 8x larger but higher compliance costs (GDPR). Constraints: legal review needed, marketing budget capped at $50k for pilot.

expected_flow.action: Review regulatory requirements & competitor entry points
Model break-even point, identify highest-value segments
Launch pilot in DE/FR only with localized compliance wrapper

expected_flow.result: Pilot MRR 18% (missed target), but compliance score 1.2. Decision: revise targeting & expand to DE only next cycle
